topic: Taxila in today's Pakistan: an ancient centre of learning on trade routes, and home of the beautiful Gandhara art in stone.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: Taxila’s Stone Surprise

shots.narration: A sparkle, a jump—what treasures await in Taxila?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, ancient Taxila stone courtyard in bright sunlight, golden time-travel sparkles and floating dust, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock materialize inside a swirling ring of golden sparkles.
shots.mood: Glowing blue watch, brilliant gold sparks, wide-eyed wonder.

shots.scene: Ancient Taxila, sunlit stone buildings beside a dusty path, green hills beyond, vertical cinematic 3D frame, no signs.
shots.action: Zoya spreads her arms toward the stone buildings.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, open sky, welcoming historical setting.

shots.narration: [excited] Long ago, Taxila was a centre of learning.
shots.scene: Shaded stone courtyard in ancient Taxila, woven mats and closed unmarked scroll bundles, bright sunlight along the floor, no visible writing.
shots.action: Zoya leans forward to examine the learning space.
shots.mood: Curious eyes, peaceful shade, inviting warm stone.

shots.narration: It also stood on trade routes.
shots.scene: Dusty road through ancient Taxila, stone buildings, plain pottery and tied cloth bundles beside a courtyard entrance, no markings.
shots.mood: Golden road dust, bright distance, adventurous anticipation.

shots.narration: But their path ends at a muddy puddle!
shots.scene: Narrow stone passage in ancient Taxila, broad shallow muddy puddle across the walkway, dry side passage visible nearby.
shots.action: Zoya stops at the puddle's edge.
shots.mood: Muddy reflections, raised eyebrows, gentle comic frustration.

shots.narration: [giggles] Tock's tiny legs vote for a drier route.
shots.scene: Stone passage beside the shallow puddle, dry side passage opening into sunlight, vertical cinematic 3D frame.
shots.action: Tock points emphatically toward the dry side passage.
shots.mood: Comically serious glass face, curled spring tail, warm sunlight.

shots.scene: Dry stone side passage in ancient Taxila, bright courtyard visible through its open end, no inscriptions.
shots.action: Zoya leads Tock along the dry passage.
shots.mood: Confident smile, sunlit exit, playful discovery.

shots.narration: Beyond the puddle waits something beautiful.
shots.scene: Quiet Taxila courtyard with an uninscribed Gandhara stone relief depicting draped human figures, respectfully presented in soft sunlight.
shots.action: Zoya stops before the stone relief.
shots.mood: Soft golden light, delighted faces, graceful carved details.

shots.narration: [surprised] Taxila is home to beautiful Gandhara art in stone.
shots.scene: Close view of the Gandhara stone relief, carefully carved drapery and faces, no lettering, Zoya and Tock beside it.
shots.action: Tock tilts his round glass face toward the carving.
shots.mood: Warm stone textures, sparkling eyes, quiet admiration.

shots.narration: They look closely, keeping their hands away.
shots.scene: Sunlit Taxila courtyard, uninscribed Gandhara relief at a respectful viewing distance, rich stone textures.
shots.action: Zoya clasps her hands behind her back.
shots.mood: Gentle smile, careful posture, peaceful appreciation.

shots.narration: A muddy detour became a wonderful discovery.
shots.scene: Taxila courtyard beside the Gandhara relief, dry passage behind the travelers, golden afternoon sunlight.
shots.action: Zoya gives Tock a cheerful thumbs-up.
shots.mood: Satisfied smiles, glowing stone, friendly adventure payoff.

shots.scene: Ancient Taxila courtyard, Zoya's blue wristwatch glowing amid fresh golden sparkles, vertical cinematic 3D frame, no text.
shots.action: Tock gestures toward Zoya's glowing wristwatch.
shots.mood: Bright blue glow, dancing gold sparks, eager anticipation.

episode.endHook: The blue watch glows again—where will their next adventure begin?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock explore ancient Taxila in today’s Pakistan, a centre of learning on trade routes. A little detour leads them to beautiful Gandhara art carved in stone.
